name: gptimg
description: Generate, edit and read images with OpenAI from TypeScript, then mask, compose and upscale them locally.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit --composite false && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit --composite false && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit --composite false
scripts.typecheck:app: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit --composite false && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit --composite false
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck -w gptimgsdk && vitest run
scripts.test:full: npm test && npm run test:live -w gptimgsdk
